dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular ring structures with high-contrast serrated outer perimeters; gradient transitions from dark charcoal exterior fur to high-intensity light grey/white interiors. Prominent elongated ovoid structure on the upper posterior-left flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters localized along the lateral-ventral transition. High concentration of core-pixel high-intensity clusters observed near the tail-base region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface form an obtuse scalene triangle. The large posterior-left annulus acts as the primary vertex relative to the smaller central-dorsal pair.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent bifurcated, 'V' shaped light patch on the mid-lateral surface, significantly larger and more linear in geometry than the surrounding circular annuli.
